description.zh:
幂等Token，保证请求幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken 只支持 ASCII 字符，且不能超过 64 个字符。更多信息，请参考文档《[如何保证幂等性](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/ecs/developer-reference/how-to-ensure-idempotence)》。
description.en:
The idempotency token that ensures the idempotence of the request.

Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure that the value is unique across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see References [How to ensure idempotence](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/ecs/developer-reference/how-to-ensure-idempotence).
The configuration of the credential provider.

description.zh:
凭据提供商标识。

> 允许的字符为：大小写英文字母、数字、特殊字符`.-_` ，并且长度不能超过64个字符。
description.en:
The business identifier of the credential provider.

> Allowed characters include uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, and the special characters `.-_`. The length cannot exceed 64 characters.

description.zh:
凭据提供商名称。

> 长度不能超过64个字符。
description.en:
The name of the credential provider.

> The length cannot exceed 64 characters.

description.zh:
凭据提供商类型。取值可选范围：

- oauth：OAuth凭据提供商
- jwt：JWT凭据提供商
description.en:
The type of the credential provider. Valid values:

- oauth: OAuth credential provider
- jwt: JWT credential provider

description.zh:
描述。

> 长度不能超过128个字符。
description.en:
The description.

> The length cannot exceed 128 characters.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eiam create-credential-provider --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --client-token client-token-example --credential-provider-identifier test_example_identifier --credential-provider-name test_example_name --description This_is_an_example_description --credential-provider-type oauth --credential-provider-config '{"JwtProviderConfig":{"AllowedTokenIssuers":["https://test.issuer.com"],"ExpirationCleanupEnabled":true,"Expiration":900,"DerivedShortTokenEnabled":false},"OAuthProviderConfig":{"TokenEndpoint":"https://example.com/token","Scope":"example:test_01_example:test_02","ClientSecret":"client_secret_example_xxx","ClientId":"client_id_example_xxx"}}' --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eiam CreateCredentialProvider --region cn-hangzhou --Description This_is_an_example_description --InstanceId idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --CredentialProviderConfig.JwtProviderConfig.AllowedTokenIssuers.1 'https://test.issuer.com' --CredentialProviderConfig.OAuthProviderConfig.Scope 'example:test_01_example:test_02' --CredentialProviderType oauth --CredentialProviderConfig.OAuthProviderConfig.ClientSecret client_secret_example_xxx --CredentialProviderConfig.JwtProviderConfig.ExpirationCleanupEnabled true --CredentialProviderName test_example_name --CredentialProviderConfig.OAuthProviderConfig.TokenEndpoint 'https://example.com/token' --CredentialProviderConfig.JwtProviderConfig.DerivedShortTokenEnabled false --CredentialProviderConfig.JwtProviderConfig.Expiration 900 --ClientToken 'client-token-example' --CredentialProviderConfig.OAuthProviderConfig.ClientId client_id_example_xxx --CredentialProviderIdentifier test_example_identifier --method POST --force
